parameters.query:
WITH request_data AS (
    SELECT
        NULLIF($1::BIGINT, 0) AS run_id,
        NULLIF($2::TEXT, '') AS suite_code,
        NULLIF($3::TEXT, '') AS clinic_name,
        $4::INTEGER AS result_limit
),

clinic_context AS (
    SELECT
        clinic.id AS clinic_id
    FROM clinics clinic
    INNER JOIN request_data request
        ON request.clinic_name IS NOT NULL
       AND clinic.name =
           request.clinic_name
    LIMIT 1
),

selected_runs AS (
    SELECT run.*
    FROM integration_test_runs run
    CROSS JOIN request_data request
    WHERE (
            request.run_id IS NOT NULL
            AND run.id =
                request.run_id
          )
       OR (
            request.run_id IS NULL
            AND request.suite_code IS NOT NULL
            AND run.suite_code =
                request.suite_code
          )
      AND (
            request.clinic_name IS NULL
            OR run.clinic_id = (
                SELECT clinic_id
                FROM clinic_context
            )
          )
    ORDER BY
        run.started_at DESC,
        run.id DESC
    LIMIT (
        SELECT result_limit
        FROM request_data
    )
),

result_rows AS (
    SELECT result.*
    FROM integration_test_results result
    INNER JOIN selected_runs run
        ON run.id = result.run_id
)

SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN request.clinic_name IS NOT NULL
         AND NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM clinic_context
         )
            THEN FALSE

        WHEN NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM selected_runs
        )
            THEN FALSE

        ELSE TRUE
    END AS success,

    CASE
        WHEN request.clinic_name IS NOT NULL
         AND NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM clinic_context
         )
            THEN 'clinic_not_found'

        WHEN NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM selected_runs
        )
            THEN 'test_runs_not_found'

        ELSE 'integration_test_report_loaded'
    END AS result,

    JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(
        'run_count',
            (
                SELECT COUNT(*)::INTEGER
                FROM selected_runs
            ),

        'passed_run_count',
            (
                SELECT COUNT(*)::INTEGER
                FROM selected_runs
                WHERE status = 'passed'
            ),

        'failed_run_count',
            (
                SELECT COUNT(*)::INTEGER
                FROM selected_runs
                WHERE status = 'failed'
            ),

        'result_count',
            (
                SELECT COUNT(*)::INTEGER
                FROM result_rows
            ),

        'passed_result_count',
            (
                SELECT COUNT(*)::INTEGER
                FROM result_rows
                WHERE status = 'passed'
            ),

        'failed_result_count',
            (
                SELECT COUNT(*)::INTEGER
                FROM result_rows
                WHERE status IN (
                    'failed',
                    'error'
                )
            )
    ) AS summary,

    COALESCE(
        (
            SELECT JSONB_AGG(
                JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(
                    'run_id',
                        run.id,
                    'run_key',
                        run.run_key,
                    'suite_code',
                        run.suite_code,
                    'status',
                        run.status,
                    'requested_by',
                        run.requested_by,
                    'environment_name',
                        run.environment_name,
                    'started_at',
                        run.started_at,
                    'completed_at',
                        run.completed_at,
                    'summary',
                        run.summary
                )
                ORDER BY
                    run.started_at DESC,
                    run.id DESC
            )
            FROM selected_runs run
        ),
        '[]'::JSONB
    ) AS runs,

    COALESCE(
        (
            SELECT JSONB_AGG(
                JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(
                    'result_id',
                        result.id,
                    'run_id',
                        result.run_id,
                    'case_code',
                        result.case_code,
                    'status',
                        result.status,
                    'duration_ms',
                        result.duration_ms,
                    'assertion_results',
                        result.assertion_results,
                    'error_message',
                        result.error_message,
                    'completed_at',
                        result.completed_at,
                    'response_payload',
                        result.response_payload
                )
                ORDER BY
                    result.completed_at DESC,
                    result.id DESC
            )
            FROM result_rows result
        ),
        '[]'::JSONB
    ) AS test_results

FROM request_data request;

parameters.content:
## گزارش تست یکپارچه

با run_id یک اجرای مشخص یا با suite_code آخرین اجراها را مشاهده کن.

خروجی شامل Summary، Runها، Assertionها و Response Payload هر سناریو است.
